title: Build and live-verify the multi-round Roster Strategist and isolated pregame laboratory

verification.name: multi-round roster strategy and immutable pregame laboratory

taskBrief: Implement only Ticket 27 Slices 269 and 270 from docs/ticket-27-slices-267-272-roster-strategist-roadmap-v1-2026-09-21.md, building on completed Slices 267-268 at this branch base. Freeze numbered sub-slices before implementation and make one scoped commit per completed sub-slice. Slice 269 must deliver a real multi-round Roster Strategist that reads the current General, faction and directed matchup Skills; freezes the mission, deployment, map/terrain, opponent-information boundary and source/rules/Skill/model/prompt versions; chooses a score route; asks typed information-needs; obtains legal candidate choices through the existing read-only Army Builder port; calls probability, spatial, math and bounded scenario tools; compares candidates; and returns one Rules-legal 2000-point roster plus a public RosterPlan. Strategy must come from Skills and Agent deliberation, never from host or prompt preference weights. Record public hypotheses, evidence queries, candidate comparisons, purposes, predicted counters, counter-responses, invalidation triggers and plan revisions, but never request or persist hidden chain-of-thought. Slice 270 must deliver an isolated pregame scene laboratory for probability, geometry, threat exchange and bounded alternative match branches. It must prove source Room and Builder state mutation-zero, preserve unknown-not-zero semantics, bind every result to its source state and support same-state A/B candidate comparison. The deterministic acceptance uses an injected mocked Provider and is run exactly once after the final relevant code change. In addition, the user explicitly requires actual live verification: run one bounded live 2000-point Agent roster-planning session using the existing Keychain-to-isolated-Worker BYOK path, then validate the final roster through the Rules-owned port and retain the actual generated RosterPlan, typed tool receipts, redacted Provider receipt and comparison against the fixed preset roster with planStatus=no_pregame_plan. Raw credentials must never enter the K3 prompt, repository, command line, stdout/stderr, screenshots, report or logs. Stop immediately on 401/402/403, ambiguous dispatch or missing secure attachment; never silently retry. Record exact Provider calls, reported input/output tokens, estimated currency cost, latency, model/provider identity, prompt-pack/Skill routes and every honest gap. A fixture-only or hand-written plan does not satisfy live acceptance. Produce a committed verification report linking every claim to an artifact or receipt. Do not modify Rules, official source data, existing Skills, Room state, Provider infrastructure, UI or credentials. Only Critical/High findings block integration; stop after three non-converging repair rounds. Do not push.
